text: In alignment with HRAC’s mandate to provide advice to City Council, to ensure that the interests and needs of those with living/lived experiences of housing precarity, discrimination and homelessness are reflected in City programs and service delivery, I’m pleased to share the following updates: In September 2024, five HRAC members attended the Mayor’s Renter’s Action Committee Forum of tenants, tenant advocates, and non-profit housing providers to gather feedback on the formation of the committee, including its structure, mandate, priorities, and membership. In January 2025, HRAC members were invited to a consultation on the City’s Rental Replacement Policy, of which five HRAC members attended. The consultation was one of many led by City Planning and was focused on the components of the policy including, tenant relocation and assistance plan, replacement of existing rental housing,…
